rows.attempted_authority: row, raw, and task receipt hashes must match
source identity hashes are bound per proposal
model family and model hash are bound per row
license status is row-local and cannot inherit
exact checker identity is required for commits
predecessor head is part of every proposal binding
duplicate effects cannot promote exact admission
future outcomes open after all dispositions
joint-exact false rows cannot commit under exact admission
row hashes and per-unit row counts must recompute
monotonic phase receipts and current flags gate readiness

field_principles.aggregate_recomputation_receipts: Recomputes every comparative aggregate from per-unit rows in an independent pass.
field_principles.arm:exact_admission: Exact admission commits only licensed joint-exact proposal rows.
field_principles.arm:frozen: Frozen reads the future with no write-time state.
field_principles.arm:write_everything: Write-everything commits every licensed proposal and acts as the contamination control.
field_principles.atomic_disposition_records: Records exactly one Commit, Reject, Quarantine, or Defer decision for every proposal.
field_principles.attack_matrix: Shows substitution, source, model, license, checker, head, duplicate, leakage, veto, deletion, and duration attacks fail closed.
field_principles.blocked_reason: Explains why readiness is blocked when any precondition fails.
field_principles.clean_write_time_admission_ready_score: Conjunctive score for future gain without contamination, retention harm, aggregate drift, or adversarial flags.
field_principles.corpus_event_order_partition_checker_lic: Seals event order, partitions, checkers, licenses, disk, CPU, RAM, and the initial head.
field_principles.current_adversarial_flag_count: Must stay zero for the clean Exp6427 replay.
field_principles.delta_contamination_propagation_rate: Bare contamination-rate change for exact admission over frozen.
field_principles.delta_future_exact_yield: Bare future exact-yield lift for exact admission over frozen.
field_principles.duration_s: Records measured wall time without padding.
field_principles.exact_veto_override_count: Must be zero because exact rejections cannot be overridden.
field_principles.exact_work_by_arm: Reports exact checker work per arm under the matched budget.
field_principles.exp6427_gate_receipts: Pins the clean corpus gate and the Exp6417 duration quarantine context.
field_principles.factor_growth_by_arm: Reports committed factor growth per arm.
field_principles.false_accept_delta: Bare false-accept rate change for exact admission over frozen.
field_principles.false_reject_delta: Bare false-reject rate change for exact admission over frozen.
field_principles.field_provenance: Maps each field to specs, inputs, replay, reductions, attacks, or tests.
field_principles.gate:event_order: Chronological order and partitions must stay sealed.
field_principles.gate:exp6417_duration_quarantine: Exp6417 is context only because its deterministic replay duration is adversarial-flagged.
field_principles.gate:exp6427: Exp6427 must be complete, clean, row-recomputable, and adversarial-clean before Exp6428 can promote readiness.
field_principles.gate:initial_factor_head: All arms start from the same read-only head.
field_principles.gate:licenses: License validity controls commits and blocks inheritance.
field_principles.gate:raw_outputs: Raw output files and stored hashes must match before proposals bind.
field_principles.harm_underpowered_missing_and_flagged_ce: Keeps unlicensed, underpowered, missing, blocked, and flagged cells visible.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Uses a terminal prefix and states the clean replay boundary.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares cached Exp6427 deterministic replay with no new model generation.
field_principles.matched_work_receipts: Shows equal row order, evidence, checker calls, consumer budget, and initial head for all arms.
field_principles.per_proposal_source_model_license_checke: Binds every proposal to source, model, license, checker, predecessor, expiry, supersession, and refinement hashes.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Records one future outcome row for every arm and cell before aggregate calculation.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Lists all gates checked before readiness can become one.
field_principles.preregistered_frozen_write_everything_an: Defines all three arms before future outcomes open.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Shows protected upstream and ops files stayed byte-identical.
field_principles.protected_leakage_count: Must be zero because protected and future labels cannot route writes.
field_principles.protected_retention_delta: Bare protected-retention change for exact admission over frozen.
field_principles.public_factor_claim_eligibility: Limits public eligibility to this clean replay and excludes the flagged Exp6417 timing claim.
field_principles.reported_vs_recomputed_deltas: Shows reported deltas and reductions match the independent recomputation.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Content-addresses the payload with volatile fields normalized.
field_principles.runtime_field_synthesis_count: Must be zero because runtime fields come from receipts.
field_principles.status: Names the terminal safety state for the clean Exp6427 replay.
field_principles.task_phase_duration_receipts: Records monotonic phase timing without synthetic duration fields.
field_principles.tests_run: Records verification commands and exit codes.
field_principles.untouched_future_evaluation_receipts: Proves future outcomes open once after proposal dispositions and head freeze.
field_principles.upstream_model_process_raw_output_and_ro: Binds model, prompt, process, raw output, and row hashes before parsing can act.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Marks only exact event and protected-retention checkers as oracles.

honest_verdict: complete: clean exact admission improved future yield without contamination or retention harm

public_factor_claim_eligibility.scope: Exp6428 deterministic replay over clean Exp6427 rows
